sources.title: Value Added Tax Brochure (FAQ)
sources.coverage: VAT standard rate 15%; zero-rating on exports; registration thresholds; exempt supplies list; filing obligations
sources.notes: 3-page official brochure downloaded 2026-07-26 from gra.gm (official GRA domain). Names the governing Act ("Income and Value Added Tax Act 2012") but does not cite a specific section number for the rate itself — an agency-published guide, not the raw statute text (same category as ZAF-SARS-VAT-GUIDE precedent). Full primary statute text not located/archived in this cycle (National Assembly of The Gambia and gambialii.org were unreachable from this environment — proxy tunnel failures, not confirmed server-side blocks). Corrects a prior placeholder that fabricated a 2011-01-01 date and cited a nonexistent generic "General Tax Code".
